title: JJS AUTO BUILDER V3 FIXED
features:
Patch Update – Auto Build JJS V3

• Fixed GUI issues affecting mobile executors.
• Added Logic Support To Building / Stealing.
• Added new build modes: Batch, Rapid, and Normal.
• Resolved language-related bugs.
• Added full Turkish language for turkish people.
• Removed the AI tab (it was unstable and unnecessary).
• Fixed major issues related to building and file loading.

Features --

Multi-language support

Save world position for the stealer

Ground snap for straight and perfectly aligned builds

Built-in tutorial/onboarding system

Favorites system for quick access to frequently used builds

Blueprint system (save and load builds)

Customizable keyboard shortcuts

Hologram/preview placement before building
